verdict.rationale: Docs confirm in-house KYC/KYB compliance handling, account holder application approval flow, manual review state with identity document collection, and internal notes for servicing — covering the core of the story. However, there's no documented breakdown of specific data requirements per verification type, no explicit re-verification/periodic refresh flow, and review-state transitions beyond 'manual review' aren't detailed. Missing for 10: documented data requirements per KYC/KYB type, explicit re-verification/refresh flows, and full review-state lifecycle documentation.
